### Reforged Eden 2 Build Number

26

### Game mode

Survival, Single Player

### Description of issue

I tried to relocate an "Industrial Water Extractor" within my base, which worked at first glance, but when I tried to place something else at the location where I removed the extractor, the area was blocked.
Placing some carbon blocks I figured out that there are two l-shaped areas outlining one edge of the extractor place 6 blocks in hight.
Some ascii grafic might explain that better (x are the blocked places, o the free outlines of the removed extractor):
```
xxoooxx
xooooox
ooooooo
ooooooo

ooooooo
```
The extractor I removed was the first one I placed which I initally upgraded to my primary. Somewhat later I added some more enxractors as my base grew. Then I finally places a science console for convenience and transered the control of the extractor network.
Duplicating a savegame, I tested different orders on how to remove the extractor from the network and the base, but nothing seems to "release" the blocked blocks.
Something "remains" at the old location, mabe something from the extractor upgrade process? Besides resolving the issue in general, is it somehow possible to remove that hidden entity from the base model in a running game?

So it's not allocated in the default case.

corec: only use _alloca with MSVC

It doesn't support variable length array in C.

corec: remove alloca definition

It's only used in rare cases with MSVC.
corec: declare the MEMHEAP_DEFAULT content in one place

corec: assume stddef.h contains uintptr_t/intptr_t in MSVC

Older MSVC compilers are not supported anymore.

corec: don't define a lowercase "inline" define
